scope: Private DOM-free mapping of exact renderer-input source spans; no native import/runtime wiring or authoring claim
sourceContract: Inclusive one-based UTF-8 source columns become half-open JavaScript string offsets. Authored labels and newline characters remain unchanged; generated DOM IDs and hrefs are not identities.
covered: All emitted reference and direct definition positions in the captured authenticated host HTML map to their source labels
Repeated references without the footnote-ref CSS class remain discoverable through host reference attributes and exact source spans
Unicode and NBSP labels, percent sequences and case variants remain exact authored strings
Nested definitions, table references, multiblock bodies and duplicate definition spans map without deriving IDs from anchors
Positions inside UTF-8 characters, unsafe/out-of-bounds coordinates and lone surrogate input are refused
LF, CRLF and CR source offsets retain the exact original newline bytes/characters; these newline cases are synthetic index tests, not extra host captures
Source bytes are bounded and per-line byte boundary arrays are cached
remaining: Wire safe stable internal IDs and separate raw source labels into native schema nodes
Validate mapped source against converted host structure and remove only renderer-owned back-reference chrome
Discover and represent unused/omitted definition bodies through a verified host-render boundary
Export source and edited labels/body semantics, including duplicate/case-varied/repeated references
Insert/edit/navigation/rename/deletion UI, captured ownership, history and permissions
Real native service save/reopen/restart and reader/navigation/browser/context/role acceptance
guards: The existing source-loss refusal remains enabled. This helper does not replace Fountain-specific source snapshots or the host renderer, nor impose CommonMark AST equality.
unchanged: Public engine, native runtime installation, package entry points/versions, size limits and parity rows
